heading.en: The path of a cricket ball

hook.en: A six over long-on rises, slows, and falls back in a smooth curve. Gravity pulls only downwards, so the horizontal velocity never changes.
hook.kn: ಲಾಂಗ್-ಆನ್ ಮೇಲೆ ಹೊಡೆದ ಸಿಕ್ಸರ್ ಮೇಲೇರಿ, ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ, ನಯವಾದ ವಕ್ರರೇಖೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಬೀಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಗುರುತ್ವ ಕೇವಲ ಕೆಳಕ್ಕೆ ಎಳೆಯುವುದರಿಂದ ಅಡ್ಡ ವೇಗ ಬದಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

narration.en: A six over long-on rises, slows, and falls back in a smooth curve. Gravity pulls only downwards, so the horizontal velocity never changes.
narration.kn: ಲಾಂಗ್-ಆನ್ ಮೇಲೆ ಹೊಡೆದ ಸಿಕ್ಸರ್ ಮೇಲೇರಿ, ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ, ನಯವಾದ ವಕ್ರರೇಖೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಬೀಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಗುರುತ್ವ ಕೇವಲ ಕೆಳಕ್ಕೆ ಎಳೆಯುವುದರಿಂದ ಅಡ್ಡ ವೇಗ ಬದಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

body.en: A projectile thrown with speed u at angle θ has a horizontal component $u\cos\theta$, which stays constant, and a vertical component $u\sin\theta$, which changes with acceleration −g. Eliminating t gives $y = x\tan\theta - \dfrac{g x^2}{2u^2\cos^2\theta}$, a parabola. Air resistance is neglected.
body.kn: u ಜವದಲ್ಲಿ θ ಕೋನದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಸೆದ ಉತ್ಕ್ಷೇಪಕದ ಅಡ್ಡ ಘಟಕ u cosθ ಸ್ಥಿರವಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ; ಲಂಬ ಘಟಕ u sinθ, −g ವೇಗೋತ್ಕರ್ಷದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಅದರ ಪಥ ಪರವಲಯ.

points.en: At the top, vᵧ = 0 but vₓ = u cos θ

say.en: Split the launch velocity into a horizontal part u cos theta and a vertical part u sin theta. Gravity acts only on the vertical part.
Write x and y against time, then eliminate t. The path is a parabola.
At 20 metres per second, 45 degrees gives the greatest range, 40 metres. 30 and 60 degrees land at the same spot.
From the equations we get the time of flight, the greatest height and the range.

narration.en: On the board: Projectile: two motions at once.

title.en: Time of flight, maximum height and range

body.en: Time of flight $T = 2u\sin\theta/g$. Maximum height $H = u^2\sin^2\theta/2g$. Horizontal range $R = u^2\sin 2\theta/g$, which is greatest at θ = 45°, where $R_{max} = u^2/g$. Angles θ and 90° − θ give the same range.
body.kn: ಹಾರಾಟದ ಕಾಲ T = 2u sinθ/g, ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಎತ್ತರ H = u² sin²θ/2g, ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ R = u² sin2θ/g. θ = 45° ನಲ್ಲಿ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ. θ ಮತ್ತು 90° − θ ಕೋನಗಳಿಗೆ ಒಂದೇ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ.

narration.en: Time of flight $T = 2u\sin\theta/g$. Maximum height $H = u^2\sin^2\theta/2g$. Horizontal range $R = u^2\sin 2\theta/g$, which is greatest at θ = 45°, where $R_{max} = u^2/g$. Angles θ and 90° − θ give the same range.
narration.kn: ಹಾರಾಟದ ಕಾಲ T = 2u sinθ/g, ಗರಿಷ್ಠ ಎತ್ತರ H = u² sin²θ/2g, ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ R = u² sin2θ/g. θ = 45° ನಲ್ಲಿ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ ಗರಿಷ್ಠ. θ ಮತ್ತು 90° − θ ಕೋನಗಳಿಗೆ ಒಂದೇ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿ.

Do the yellow and green paths always land at the same point? Which one stays in the air longer?

problem.en: A ball is thrown at 20 m/s at 30° above the horizontal. Find its time of flight, maximum height and range (g = 10 m/s²).

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A ball is thrown at 20 m/s at 30° above the horizontal. Find its time of flight, maximum height and range (g = 10 m/s²).

problem.en: A stone is thrown horizontally at 15 m/s from the top of a cliff 45 m high. When and how far from the foot of the cliff does it land? (g = 10 m/s²)

steps.en: Vertically it starts from rest: 45 = ½ × 10 × t², so t = 3 s.
Horizontally it moves uniformly: x = 15 × 3 = 45 m.

answer.en: After 3 s, 45 m from the foot of the cliff

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A stone is thrown horizontally at 15 m/s from the top of a cliff 45 m high. When and how far from the foot of the cliff does it land? (g = 10 m/s²)

body.en: θ and 90° − θ give the same range, for example 30° and 60°. Also H/R = tan θ / 4 for every launch, so at 45° the range is four times the maximum height.

narration.en: Complementary angles, same range. θ and 90° − θ give the same range, for example 30° and 60°. Also H/R = tan θ / 4 for every launch, so at 45° the range is four times the maximum height.

mnemonic.en: Range loves 45; partner angles add to 90.

narration.en: A ball is launched from the ground. Set its speed and angle so it lands exactly on the flag at x = 40 m.

prompt.en: A ball is launched from the ground. Set its speed and angle so it lands exactly on the flag at x = 40 m.

hint.en: R = v² sin 2θ / g. The range is largest at 45°.

explanation.en: Range R = v² sin 2θ / g. With 20 m/s at 40°: 400 × 0.985 / 9.8 ≈ 40.2 m. Other pairs work too: any v and θ with v² sin 2θ ≈ 392.
